AUDIENCE & TESTABILITY:
API audience: ADVANCED/LOW-LEVEL
Harness testability: TESTABLE
Scoring recommendation: include only in advanced/internal bucket

ROOT CAUSE:
The documentation incorrectly provided a "Valid Call Pattern" that instantiates a `ThumbnailParameterBuilder`. This builder class is either package-private or not located in the `net.coobird.thumbnailator` package, causing a `cannot find symbol` compilation error. The `getInstance()` methods themselves are perfectly testable in isolation and do not require being passed into a builder to be exercised.

CORRECT USAGE:
```java
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory resizerFactory = net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance();
net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.SwapDimensions swapFilter = net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.SwapDimensions.getInstance();

if (resizerFactory == null || swapFilter == null) {
    throw new IllegalStateException("Instances should not be null");
}
```

REQUIRED TYPES & IMPORTS:
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory
net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.DefaultResizerFactory
net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.SwapDimensions

DOC MUST SAY:
- Do not attempt to use `ThumbnailParameterBuilder` to demonstrate `getInstance()`, as it is not publicly accessible in the expected package and will cause a compilation error.
- To test or use the API, simply call `DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance()` and `SwapDimensions.getInstance()` directly and assign them to their respective types.
